evidence_policy.correlation: finite predictions joined by config_id to a unique complete measured oracle; if legal is incomplete, use successful stock-raw trials with legal_oracle_complete=false and an explicit denominator
evidence_policy.excluded: cache-only, collected-only, missing/duplicate trial, and failed-run records are not performance evidence
evidence_policy.oracle: every legal config in z3-legal-exhaustive must compile, validate, and profile successfully
evidence_policy.performance: run_end=ok, one terminal trial per selected config, complete phase intervals, and a best successful trial are required
evidence_policy.quality: a complete legal oracle is preferred; otherwise quality uses the full stock-raw measured optimum with quality_reference=stock-raw
